description: normalizeEntries uses !Number.isNaN(parseInt(key,10)) instead of shouldCoerceToNumber, coercing array indices above MAX_ARRAY_INDEX (1,000,000) to numbers — no deepKeys test exercises a sparse array with an index exceeding that bound
productionImpact: When deepKeys traverses an array with a numeric index above 1,000,000 (e.g. a high-water-mark sparse buffer), the over-large index is coerced to a number and emitted as a bracket path. Any downstream code that uses this path with getProperty or setProperty will treat the segment as a numeric array index and attempt to allocate a > 1,000,000 element array, exhausting memory and crashing the process.
